name: Locus
summary: One account for an AI agent to use thousands of paid APIs and data sources, billed per call with no separate subscriptions or keys; Locus also offers USDC wallets with spending controls, and some of its API routes answer over x402.

Commonworld's own unpaid check: an unpaid POST to https://hunter.x402.paywithlocus.com/hunter/email-verifier answered HTTP 402 with x402 v2 payment terms (scheme exact; network Base; asset USDC; price 0.008 USDC; payTo Base 0x3C5CBe28ECA3b96023c45D3f877da834F1C7d5fA). YourAITools lists the price as $0.008–$0.013. No payment was made; a 402 shows the endpoint is up and asks for payment, not that the paid service works.
